column4: Before inspecting generated output text or computing embeddings, add a versioned confirmatory scorer that validates every raw record against the frozen generation registration and correctly permits the registered old/new snapshot-specific LoRA digests; add regression tests and an immutable scoring-amendment artifact bound to the exact registration and raw-tape hashes. Do not edit frozen inputs or score yet. Disclose that this is a post-generation, pre-score amendment triggered by the registered scorer's adapter_pair_mismatch.

Independently verify the scorer amendment, registration binding, digest validation, adapter-pair logic, tests and scope caveat without editing it. Publish PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED; scoring must wait for PASS.

Only after the independent PASS, score the complete 162-row raw tape in a separate deterministic pass with the registered embedding model/runtime; retain full scores, runtime metadata, and exact hashes. Label cosine as embedding similarity, not semantic ground truth.
